note: What gets decided, and when. Every date is pre-registered - decisions are made on the evidence named here, not on the mood of the day.

items.title: Scheduled review
items.what: Reads the whole board: every gate scorecard, gamma equity, benched-0.618 progress, drawdowns, era health.

items.title: Fib-window era rotation
items.what: The anchored window rolls to a new fixed start (recorded via win_anchor stamps). Expect a small stamped burst of newly visible legs - scheduled evolution, not drift.

items.title: Breakeven twins: VERDICT — keep the pure ladder
items.what: Verdict recorded 3 days early at the owner's review: 165 completed pairs, ladder -55.8R vs BE@0.75 twin -53.9R - a 1.9R wash (~0.01R/trade = noise). Pre-registered bar not met; NO breakeven anywhere. Twins keep spawning (free) but the decision is closed. Also recorded at this review: day-breaker has blocked -199.8R lifetime (the system's most valuable rule); counter-run flagged +19.4R 'consider reverting' - hearing Aug 5 on Gamma 2.0's universe only.

items.title: Pipeline verdict: fixed-start vs rolling
items.what: THE deciding test of the anchored (fixed-start) window deployed 2026-07-20: post-fix live fills vs the engine's own simulation on the same days, all level books. Match => machine verified end-to-end (fixed start stays). Mismatch => hunt the residual defect on a now-deterministic engine. Context: test 21 showed the old rolling window earned MORE in clean simulation (+re-touches) but its live reality diverged catastrophically (6% win vs 21% simulated) and it can never be verified. Revert = one commit, with evidence. Also: did the Aug-1 era rotation behave (small stamped fill-burst, then stability)?

items.title: Gamma weather-table verdicts
items.what: Each v140 gate's shadow scorecard (runs-aligned, vix-high, day-breaker) plus the v142 VIX floor: keep what saves money, revert what costs it.

items.title: Defense quiet-weather gate: DEPLOYED (owner order)
items.what: Owner order 2026-08-04 (clean-slate era, consistency-first): deep buys enter the trade book only in QUIET weather; hostile-weather deep fills -> shadow (tag hostile-weather), fully scored. Priced on 11.3y (test 17): 2019 -59R -> +25R, 2022/2024 green, cost ~1/3 of Defense's total (compounded: 8L -> 5.7cr instead of 10.8cr - the smooth Book chosen with eyes open). REVIEW ~Aug-14 then every Friday: the gate's own shadow line says saving-or-costing; revert = one commit.

items.title: Capital translation + Pocket honesty
items.what: Re-compute per-engine minimums from months of recorded lot data (est. Rs28L all four). Pocket's wave-2 fixes + window anchoring must land before its paper line is trusted. ALSO (2026-08-04, owner-prompted study): yearly REBALANCING across books COSTS wealth here - isolated compounding Rs32L->7.69cr vs 4-way rebalanced 4.31cr (a persistent champion + Gem's zero-line make rebalancing an annual tax; 3-way no-Gem recovers to 6.66cr). Isolated ends ~80% concentrated in Defense. Graduation menu: let-winners-run WITH a concentration cap (e.g. sweep only above ~60% share) - compute the capped line then. OWNER DESIGN NOTE 2026-08-04 ('sizing needs intelligence after a certain size'): compounding at 1% only while a book is small; past a ceiling (~Rs 1cr/book, exact number from recorded fill-time spread data) risk FREEZES in rupees (linear growth = the owner's 20-30%/yr consistency goal), with per-symbol capacity caps (index full size, stock options capped by depth). Live layer only - paper stays at 1% for clean R records. SIZING-SCHEME BACKTEST (2026-08-04, same baked fills, 24L start): 1%-compound 6.98cr end / worst yr -33.6L / max trade 9.2L / max dd 4.29cr; CEILING-1cr (Idea 1) 4.31cr / worst yr +3.7L (NO red years) / max trade 1L / dd 61.5L / 2026 +10.1L; sqrt 1.63cr (over-throttles); tiered 1/.5/.25% 4.26cr / worst +1.5L / dd 53.4L. Skim variant == ceiling, profits above 1cr leave the broker. Ceiling = ~28%/yr = owner's stated happy zone. Recommendation on record: Idea 1 (skim flavour); decide at graduation. IDEA 5 - OWNER'S RUPEE LADDER (2026-08-04, owner design, 'no change for now'): risk rungs 1L@1cr/2L@2cr/2.5L@3cr/3L@4cr/3.5L@5cr/4L@6cr/cap 5L@8cr+. Backtest 24L: 5.70cr end / 31.7% CAGR / still ZERO red years (worst +1.3L) / max-dd 1.99cr (vs 61.5L hard-cap); at 150L start holds 24.7% vs 18.0%. Verdict deferred to graduation: adopt rungs only as far as MEASURED fill-time spreads support (2.5-5L risk = 15-25 lots, unverified on stock options); smooth the 1cr->2cr doubling. Engines stay hard-cap 1L. => IDEA 5 DEPLOYED 2026-08-04 same night (owner: 'change it'): ladder live in paper_levels/paper_gamma/baker/app (identical constants, app verified to-the-rupee). Hard cap superseded. Graduation question narrows to: how far up the ladder do measured spreads let real money climb. => FINAL SIZING LAW 2026-08-04 (owner 'lets do it'): SMOOTH 50K/cr slope replaces the stepped ladder - 1% under 1cr, then 1L + 50K/cr pro-rated continuously, 5L cap from 9cr. Backtest 24L: 5.49cr / 31.3% CAGR / dd 1.78cr; flicker test 18-34L starts: monotone (steps were chaotic). Deployed in both engines + baker + app.

items.title: REMINDER: storm-species detection (owner point 4)
items.what: Owner asked to be reminded (2026-08-04). Question: can the daily positioning recorder (FII stress flows S1/S2 - already proven to lead hostile days 62%->76% - plus VIX/GEX/PCR) distinguish snap-back storms (feed Defense) from grind-storms (2019-type, starve it)? If yes: a smarter Defense gate that only benches GRIND-storms - most of the protection at a fraction of the premium. Needs the recorder's accumulated data + the archived-era outcomes to label storm types. SHORT-SIDE RE-AUDIT (2026-08-06, owner ask, chat-only): deployed rulebook mirrored to shorts. Pocket shorts -91.4R (original ruling holds). Scalper shorts +90.9R but +0.02R/trade - too thin. HEADLINE: Defense shorts are the WEATHER MIRROR - quiet shorts -89.4R, HOSTILE-ONLY shorts +559.5R/4408 fills (+0.127R/trade), paying exactly when long-Defense hurts (2019 +121R, 2020 +215R, 2022 +132R). Combined long-quiet + short-hostile ~= +1080R BUT 3 red years vs 1 (2016/2021/2024 snap-back storms run over shorts) - consistency trade-off vs owner doctrine. If ever pursued: shadow audition first, never straight to trade book.

items.title: Sentinel check #30: backtest freshness
items.what: Found 2026-08-03: the app served a Pocket backtest baked Jul-3 with the pre-fix candle grouping (session-anchored resample landed Jul-9) - stale for 3+ weeks, total read +270.6R vs true +122.7R. Decide + implement: integrity sentinel invariant - every docs/backtest_*.json generated_at must postdate the last commit touching fibleg/strategy|data|indicators, else red badge. Also standing rule: any engine-code change => re-bake before trusting tables.
